scope: Original papers and official source files actually inspected for 12.13; all full texts remain outside Git.

sources.inspection_note: PDF p.2 §§2.1–2.2 Property 1 and Theorem 2; p.3 §3.1. Read the countable-universe and fixed-size qualifications. Only the forward implication that a sum/mean is permutation invariant is used; no universality claim is imported.

PDF p.2 §2.1 audio/transcript pairing and 30-second segmentation; p.3 §§2.2–2.3 input positions, transcription targets, task tokens and separate 20-ms timestamp tokens; p.4 Figure 1. The paper supports the task/representation distinction, not a claim that this repository implements Whisper or has ASR quality.

filters.py lines 128–248, especially 217–241: n_mels+2 mel-spaced boundaries; lower/upper slopes; maximum(0,minimum(lower,upper)). Compared the textbook’s unnormalized HTK recipe; did not equate it to librosa’s default Slaney normalization.
convert.py lines 1180–1212 hz_to_mel, 1254–1286 mel_to_hz, and 1648–1693 mel_frequencies. Read both 2595*log10(1+f/700) and its inverse; several mel conventions coexist.

functional.py lines 507–690: STFT formula, center/pad_mode, real-input onesided frequency count and frame count; lines 674–679 apply n_fft//2 reflection padding. Downloaded pinned source SHA equals the installed module SHA ab3bf6b6dd9c4928129da9115aad0acc3514fa45e052634a2f233ff7b10c37af.

_torch_docs.py lines 834–866 allclose with rtol=1e-5 and atol=1e-8; 4241–4263 equal; 7195–7240 mean dim reduction; 11546–11577 flip. Also read the installed API docstrings. These API contracts support comparisons and axis operations, not generic model competence.

Opening paragraphs, lines 5–17: finite floating precision, non-associative addition and multiplication, operation order affecting results; no guarantee of bitwise-identical results across releases/platforms. This explains why mathematical invariance is checked with allclose rather than exact equality.
AdaptivePooling.h lines 31–37: start floor(i*L/S), end ceil((i+1)*L/S). These are supports in the input sequence to pooling, not isolated raw-waveform supports after a bidirectional GRU.
Pooling.cpp lines 43–52: 1D pooling unsqueezes into adaptive_avg_pool2d with output size {1,S}, then squeezes. Read together with endpoint source s8 and the actual explicit-interval comparison in a1.
